```python
def validate_request(data):

    if not isinstance(data, dict):
        return False
    if set(data.keys()) != {'members', 'timestamp', 'comment'}:
        return False
    
    # Validate members
    if not isinstance(data['members'], list):
        return False
    if len(data['members']) < 1 or len(data['members']) > 64:
        return False
    
    # Validate timestamp
    if not isinstance(data['timestamp'], list):
        return False
    if len(data['timestamp']) != 6:
        return False
    try:

    except (ValueError, TypeError):
        return False
    if not all(isinstance(v, int) for v in [year, month, day, hour, minute, second]):
        return False
    # Check year range
    if year < 1980 or year > 2107:
        return False
    # Check even second
    if second % 2 != 0:
        return False
    # Validate date/time using calendar
    import calendar
    try:
        calendar.monthrange(year, month)
    except (ValueError, TypeError):
        return False
    if day < 1 or day > calendar.monthrange(year, month)[1]:
        return False
    if hour < 0 or hour > 23:
        return False
    if minute < 0 or minute > 59:
        return False
    if second < 0 or second > 59:
        return False
    
    # Validate comment
    if not isinstance(data['comment'], str):
        return False
    if len(data['comment']) > 200:
        return False
    
    # Validate each member
    paths = set()
    for member in data['members']:
        if not isinstance(member, dict):
            return False
        if set(member.keys()) != {'path', 'content_b64', 'mode'}:
            return False
        
        # Validate path
        if not isinstance(member['path'], str):
            return False
        if member['path'].startswith('/'):
            return False
        if '\\' in member['path']:
            return False
        parts = member['path'].split('/')
        if any(p == '' or p == '.' or p == '..' for p in parts):
            return False
        if member['path'] in paths:
            return False
        paths.add(member['path'])
        
        # Validate content_b64
        if not isinstance(member['content_b64'], str):
            return False
        # Strict base64 validation
        try:
            decoded = base64.b64decode(member['content_b64'], validate=True)
        except Exception:
            return False
        if len(decoded) > 64 * 1024:  # 64 KiB
            return False
        
        # Validate mode
        if not isinstance(member['mode'], int):
            return False
        if member['mode'] < 0 or member['mode'] > 511:
            return False
    
    return True
```
